summary: Rewrite analysis.py as L1 logistic on raw+pairwise products, nested-CV pilot-only, write cv_auc alone
reasoning: The pairs route's step-14 established (pilot-only, nested CV) that a logistic regression on the 66 pairwise products reaches cv_auc 0.8923, so interaction features are the right family for linear models here. My L1 route reuses that feature family — 12 raw + 66 products = 78 candidates — with an L1 penalty whose C is tuned strictly inside the cross-validation (outer 5-fold; inner 5-fold GridSearchCV over 13 log-spaced C values on the outer training part only). Expected cv_auc is near the pairs route's 0.89, well above the 0.80 milestone; the risk that L1's selection over-shrinks is bounded because the grid reaches C=100. Heldout stays sealed in this run.
